prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in League City, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1112; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, so just go ahead with the claim questions.

Q: That's fine, we can note that. Where were you when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through an intersection in League City, Texas, turning left onto the main road.

Q: Which direction were you traveling before the turn?

A: Straight through the intersection from the north side. I had a green light, or at least I thought I did, and I started to make the left.

Q: What happened next?

A: A vehicle coming from the opposite direction hit the front driver's side of my car. It came through the intersection faster than I expected.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began your turn?

A: I saw headlights, but they were far enough away that I figured I had time. I should have waited longer.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My neck and lower back got wrenched when the airbag went off and I was thrown against the seat belt. I've had stiffness and pain since.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon and I'm scheduled to see a physical therapist next week. The doctor said it looks like a neck and back strain.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add?

A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I want this handled properly. I'm still sore and I'm not sure how long recovery will take.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
